title: A fresh question and a fair answer

captions.emotions: Feeling fairness in an appropriate measure

meaning: A fresh question can help you reconsider familiar foundations and form a shared view proportionate to particular experience.
text: A fresh question can be more useful than arguing about an old definition. The Emperor in the physical position of Ajna suggests examining familiar foundations of assessment stepwise. The Fool in energy supports open exploration without a predetermined conclusion. Justice in emotions responds with fairness in an appropriate measure. You enjoy seeing an answer fit particular experience.

For example, you describe the route home through a park differently: one calls it a walk, the other an ordinary journey. Beyond choosing one correct word, you compare what each expected from that time. **A fresh question can reveal a measure belonging to your particular experience.** Moving somewhere becomes distinguishable from having time to linger without hurry. Both assessments acquire a foundation. You understand why the same route felt different while preserving both impressions’ value. Each person’s wish can now be discussed without asking one word to resolve the entire question.

The difficulty is treating a successful distinction as another final classification. Every subsequent outing again needs an exact definition. Free exploration retains meaning when other circumstances can invite another question. Fairness also concerns the scale of a conclusion. Today’s experience gained an explanation while future experience still has to reveal what matters to both people within it.
